news.text: 🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "Which aspect convinces me the most and which one, instead, worries me a bit more? It convinces me when I see the players having the right attitude. What worries me is when there is a lack of ability to find space and the opponents play the ball behind your back, leading you to concede a goal because of a decision not made. Undecided actions are worse than the wrong ones. If you make a decision, even if you decide poorly, it is less serious than not making a decision at all. A decision not made is the worst of all. Therefore, this tendency to stand there hesitating, without taking on the situation, is a problem. The opponents organize themselves correctly

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "What gives me the most satisfaction? I wouldn't want to single out anyone, because there are those who did the dirty work, like #Lucumí, who perhaps isn't in his natural role and found himself having to play the ball with his right foot many times. #Kalulu is on his tenth or fifteenth match playing the full 90 minutes and poor guy, at the end, he almost wanted to ask for a substitution. These are all positive signs, but what truly matters is that we pushed into their half, accepting to play man-to-man for a long time. Then you take risks, because they have a goalkeeper who knows how to play with his feet and he completely nullifies all your pressing and

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "Substitutes? The players who came on can truly cause damage in a match like this, because #Boga has that burst of pace, #Ekhator is a young player who needs to do the specific job he knows how to do, which fits his characteristics. Instead, we dropped too deep, we stopped playing out cleanly, we no longer had any reference points and we all remained caught halfway in between".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "Several players, like #KoloMuani and #Koopmeiners, gave important answers? When you play matches like this, on a pitch like this, where they haven't lost at home in 17 matches, it means you come here to play your game with authority, strength, quality and the right kind of courage. It is not down to just one person. #KoloMuani had 4/5 balls played into him: if he manages to find a layoff and take off into those spaces, he is unstoppable. We, however, never managed to clean up that second ball which would have allowed us to reorganize and get back to attacking the spaces. We had to suffer on the edge of our penalty area. But we did well regardless, becaus

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "How do I evaluate the match we played? That we held on? You have to score the goal to close it out, you shouldn't just hold on. The concept is completely flipped, it's the exact opposite, you must close out matches, not hold on".[@juventusinsidernews]

#KOLO IN TRUE #JUVE STYLE#Spalletti is fifthHe wins at #AZ's home (2-1): third victory, 10 points in 4 matches. In Europe, it's a different #Muani: assist and goal, Lucio says thanks.He sets up the opening goal for #Koop and scores the second: his third goal after those against #NEC and #Celta. A thrilling finale: #Meerdink scores, then #DeWit's 2-2 is disallowed for offside.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE, FISTS TO THE SKY#Koopmeiners and a great #Kolo beat #AZ. Then #Spalletti gets furious over the final jitters: 2-1.The first half was dominated by the K-Factor, with Teun delivering his best performance in front of his brother Peer. The Dutch never created any real danger, but the defense lost concentration and brought them back into the game in the final minutes: #Spalletti got furious with #Cabal. "Great football, then as soon as you drop your level even for a moment... If it had lasted another 5 minutes, we wouldn't have brought the win home". #Ekhator is back.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "Did we drop our level in the second half? Yes, as soon as you drop your level even for a moment, as we've seen in the Champions League and in the Europa League, the opponents always make you pay. What they do once, they do with conviction, with strength, repeating over time. Because even a behavior that initially might seem hesitant, becomes a strength through repetition. Their strength is precisely that of always beating us with great intensity in in-game situations. We sat back and waited, our wide center-backs stopped pushing out, we were doing the 'Should I go, should I not go, I'll go, but I won't go', staying caught in the middle. Ball behind our b

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "An important victory against a team that hadn't lost at home in Europe for 17 matches? I am extremely satisfied, they played a serious match against a very strong team. Otherwise, I remind all of you about #NEC again, when you were laughing in our faces because we had beaten #NEC and you were saying they were a weak team, now they have 7 points. So there is something to review regarding our perspective, humility and giving the proper credit to others, without always having to put pressure on the team. You win a serious match, and tonight we won a great match, playing great football".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Federico #Gatti to 'Sky Sport': "How much of it is physical and how much is mental when looking at #KoloMuani's first hour? No, absolutely. He is an incredibly strong player, with athletic characteristics that in my opinion we sometimes don't exploit, because he is a forward who, when he attacks the space in behind, puts any defender in difficulty. I am the first to admit it: when they attack behind my back it is harder. At times, we should leverage his qualities more. But, I repeat, now we must put this match aside, because it's over, and straighten out our situation in the league because, as I've already said, we are too far from the top. 🗣 Federico #Gatti to 'Sky Sport': "In the penalty box? I have to say that in the opponent's box, you and I were very similar: we would lose our way for a brief moment, so let's put it that way. When you get into the box you are stretching so hard that you lose a bit of sharpness, you don't see anything anymore and you are a bit blurred. So it's fine, I need to be a defender and leave that to the forwards. But yes, those are actions that happen when you are doing well physically. I repeat, I need to play: you only get into match fitness by pushing through fatigue, match after match. Today it was too important to win to give continuity to Sunday's performance. 🗣Federico #Gatti to 'Sky Sport': "Is pushing forward one of my characteristics? Yes, it's a characteristic I've always had. The problem is that I need to be doing well physically, because when you are not at your best and not sharp, especially in the defensive phase, a mistake is always right around the corner. I need to get into match fitness and I can only do that by playing. I need this, that's all".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Federico #Gatti to 'Sky Sport': "Does this victory leave us with positive energy? Yes, absolutely. It is an excellent away victory, because in Europe it is always difficult, and here it is even more so. However, now we already have to put it aside, because we need to straighten out our league campaign. We cannot be in a position like this".[@juventusinsidernews]
